items.title: Rewrite the false .Codex/hooks prohibition on CLAUDE.md line 77 to state the truth (host hooks are framework-managed init assets), without hardcoding the .Codex literal
items.context: CLAUDE.md line 77 currently ends with 'Claude hook/settings 只放在 .claude/，不要创建 .Codex/hooks 或 .Codex/settings.json。'. Replace the false 'do not create .Codex/hooks' part with an accurate statement: host hook/settings are framework-managed assets generated by lattice init for each host (Claude host under .claude/, Codex adapter under its own adapter directory) and should not be hand-authored or hand-edited. Keep it generic — do NOT write the .Codex literal (B-ed70 renames it to .lattice-codex and gates on `git grep .Codex` being empty). Verify: `grep -n 'Codex/hooks' CLAUDE.md` no longer returns the prohibition; the line accurately reflects that init generates host hooks.
items.userSees: Reading CLAUDE.md, the hook section no longer claims '不要创建 .Codex/hooks'; instead it correctly states host hooks are framework-managed init assets per host, matching the actual generated .claude/hooks and Codex adapter hooks.
